M1.note: Misses the key-rate, FX and black-lender themes, treats mortgage demand as leasing capacity, and dismisses the dollar move.

M2.note: Keeping funding floating contradicts its own high-rate check, and the pilot and office-lease items are weakly grounded.

M3.note: Pricing tied to funding cost is right and ratings are covered, but it misreads A0559 as banning non-bank institutions from foreign shares.

M4.note: Decisions are tangential outage and fraud items, and it adds a 2027 year and a first-reading status not given in the sources.

M5.note: Short but sensible: hold pricing and delay credit-funded expansion, with little else covered.

M6.note: Gets the Europlan and subsidised leasing angle with a sensible launch gate, but is weak on funding cost and FX.

M7.note: Benchmarking against the peer and tracking auto leasing help, but the regional mortgage-demand decisions are weak for a lessor.
